Initial release – standardized fruit ripeness grading based on image and video analysis.

- Identifies ripeness stages (green / turning / ripe / over-ripe) using color, size, and gloss features.
- Supports analysis via local files and URLs; processes images and videos up to 10MB.
- Outputs structured ripeness grade reports and harvest window suggestions.
- Provides automated cloud-based history report queries with results in Markdown table format.
- Ensures privacy: user identity is managed internally and never exposed in outputs.
